## Summary

Added Japanese localization for the login and registration pages:

- **`lang/en/auth.json`** (new) — English catalog with the `auth.login.*` and `auth.register.*` keys, pulled verbatim from the existing page copy.
- **`lang/ja/auth.json`** (new) — Japanese translations for the same keys.
- **`lang/ja/messages.json`** (new) — Japanese translation of `welcome`, keeping the `:name` placeholder.
- **`src/app.ts`** — added `'ja'` to `i18n.supported` so the framework's built-in locale detection (query → cookie → `Accept-Language`) and catalog loading pick it up.
- **`resources/js/pages/auth/Login.tsx`** / **`Register.tsx`** — replaced hardcoded English strings (title, heading, subtitle, field labels, buttons, footer text) with `useTranslation()` calls (`@guren/inertia-client`) against the new catalog keys.
- Regenerated `.guren/translations.gen.ts` via `bunx guren codegen` (20 typed keys, both locales).
- Added **`tests/AuthI18n.test.ts`**, exercising `/login` and `/register` through `TestApp.fromApp(app)` across the header cases from the request (no header, Japanese-preferring, English-preferring, unsupported-only), and verifying the translated catalog values and the `welcome` placeholder.

`bunx guren check --i18n` confirms both catalogs have full key parity, and all other pages/routes are untouched.
